kebab_example: aliyun iotcc update-connection-pool-attribute --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --connection-pool-id cp-bp11234abctmno0hdq0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateConnectionPoolAttribute

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the cloud connector
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the connection address pool
parameters.name: connection_pool_id

parameters.help_en: The number of Internet of Things SIM cards
parameters.name: count

parameters.help_en:
The name of the connection address pool.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
连接地址池的名称。

长度为2~128个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。但不能以`http:// `或`https://`开头
parameters.name: connection_pool_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the connection address pool.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length, and start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
连接地址池的描述信息。

长度为2~256个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，但不能以`http:// `或`https://`开头
parameters.name: connection_pool_description

parameters.help_en:
The Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) blocks associated with the connection address pool. The value range of N is 1 to 20.

Multiple CIDR blocks are separated by ampersands (&), in the format `Cidrs.1=CIDR block 1&Cidrs.2=CIDR block 2`
parameters.help_zh:
连接地址池所属的CIDR地址块。N的取值范围：1~20。

多个CIDR地址块使用and（&）分隔，格式为`Cidrs.1=CIDR地址块1&Cidrs.2=CIDR地址块2`
parameters.name: cidrs

parameters.help_en:
The client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

This value is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests. It can contain up to 64 ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run of the request. Valid values:
true: Sends a dry run request without updating the connection address pool. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, whether the request format is valid, and whether business limits are exceeded. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): Sends a normal request. If the check passes, the connection address pool is updated immediately
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会更新连接地址池。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接更新连接地址池
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the cloud connector instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html API to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id
